surface_name: TypeScript SDK v2 and Zod versions
title: MCP server on SDK v2 starts fine but tools/list fails because package.json still allows Zod 3
symptoms: client.listTools() returns an error pointing at fromJsonSchema() while the server keeps running
Typecheck and startup pass, and the failure appears only on the first tools/list
cause: SDK v2 supports only Zod 4, and Zod 4.2 or later converts itself to JSON Schema. A Zod 3 range that satisfied the v1 peer installs and typechecks under v2, then registration skips the schema without throwing.
fix: Declare zod ^4.2.0 in package.json, reinstall, and confirm a single copy with npm ls zod.
apply:
"dependencies": { "@modelcontextprotocol/server": "^2.3.0", "zod": "^4.2.0" }
// then: npm install && npm ls zod
affected: @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.x; Zod 3 unsupported, Zod 4.0 to 4.1 lack self-conversion; as of 2026-10
